models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Guest actor entity representing unauthenticated visitors before they register or log in. Each guest record serves as an identity anchor for tracking sessions and collecting analytics. Guests have limited capabilities restricted to registration and login functions - they cannot access any todo management features or user profiles.

The guest identity is established via device fingerprint when available, enabling detection of returning visitors across sessions. Once a guest completes registration, they transition to a member identity and their guest record becomes inactive.

Related entities: {@link todo_app_guest_sessions} tracks session tokens and connection metadata for guest visits.

Privacy: Guest data is used internally for analytics and rate limiting only. No guest data is exposed to other users.

plainFields.name: fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device fingerprint for visitor identification. Used to detect returning visitors across sessions. May be null if fingerprint cannot be determined or is blocked by the user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access prior to authentication.

This table tracks sessions for unauthenticated visitors (guests) before they register or login. Each session captures connection metadata including IP address, current URL, and referrer for audit and rate limiting purposes.

Sessions have a defined lifecycle with expiration to ensure security. When a guest registers or logs in, their guest session transitions to a member session, and this temporary record may be cleaned up.

Relationship: Each session belongs to exactly one {@link todo_app_guests} actor.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description: The guest actor who owns this session. {@link todo_app_guests.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client connection for this guest session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL path the guest is accessing during this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the guest came from before this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest session expires for security purposes.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered user accounts with email/password credentials and display name.

This is the primary actor table for authenticated members of the todo application. Each member can create, manage, and track their private todos. The email serves as the unique authentication identifier, and the password_hash stores the securely hashed password.

Members have complete ownership of their todos and associated edit histories. When a member account is deleted, all their todos (including those in trash) and edit histories are permanently removed.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_member_sessions} - Session tokens for authenticated access
- {@link todo_app_todos} - Private todos owned by the member

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used as the unique authentication identifier for the member account. Must be unique across all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. The password is hashed using a secure algorithm and never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name shown in the member's profile. This is a private todo app so display names are not shared with other users.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated (e.g., display name change, password change).

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens tracking authenticated member sessions with connection context and temporal lifecycle management.

Each session represents a single authentication event for a todo_app_members actor, storing the JWT token identifier, client connection metadata (IP, href, referrer), and timestamps for creation, last refresh, and expiration. Sessions enforce the single-active-session-per-user policy and are invalidated on logout, password change, or account deletion.

Sessions are created upon successful authentication and provide the foundation for JWT-based access control. The token_identifier stores the JWT 'jti' claim for token validation and revocation support. The updated_at field tracks token refresh events, while expired_at defines the session's maximum validity period.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who owns this session. {@link todo_app_members.id}

plainFields.name: token_identifier
plainFields.description: Unique JWT token identifier (jti claim) for session validation and revocation support.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL endpoint accessed when creating the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the authentication request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created upon successful authentication.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was last refreshed, tracking token refresh events.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and must be re-authenticated.

models.description:
Main todo task entity for personal task management.

Each todo represents a task owned exclusively by a single member, ensuring complete privacy and isolation between users. Todos support a full lifecycle including active state, completion tracking, soft deletion to trash, and permanent removal.

Key features:
- Title and optional description for task details
- Optional start and due dates for scheduling
- Completion status for progress tracking
- Soft delete via deleted_at for trash and restore functionality
- Edit history tracked through {@link todo_app_todo_histories}

Users can only access their own todos. The deleted_at field enables trash functionality where deleted todos can be viewed separately and restored.

foreignFields.description: Owner of the todo. References {@link todo_app_members.id}. Each todo belongs exclusively to one member, ensuring complete privacy.
foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id

models.name: todo_app_todos

plainFields.description: Title of the todo task. Required field that cannot be empty or contain only whitespace. Maximum length enforced by validation rules.
plainFields.name: title

plainFields.description: Detailed description of the todo task. Optional field that can be left empty or cleared. Supports free-form text content.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Scheduled start date for the todo. Optional field indicating when work should begin. Must be equal to or earlier than due_date when both are set.
plainFields.name: start_date

plainFields.description: Deadline date for the todo. Optional field for tracking task deadlines. Must be equal to or later than start_date when both are set.
plainFields.name: due_date

plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo. Defaults to false (incomplete) on creation. Users can toggle between complete and incomplete states at any time.
plainFields.name: completed

plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the todo is considered deleted and moved to trash. Null for active todos. Enables trash and restore functionality.
plainFields.name: deleted_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Recorded automatically on creation and used for sorting and pagination.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated (e.g., title change, description change, completion toggle). Recorded automatically on modification.
plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories
models.description:
Immutable edit history entries tracking field-level changes to todos for audit trail purposes.

Each history entry records a single edit operation on a todo, capturing the timestamp of the edit and what each field was changed to. Only fields that were actually modified during an edit are populated; unchanged fields remain null. History entries are automatically created when a user edits a todo's title, description, start date, or due date.

History entries are permanently associated with their parent {@link todo_app_todos} and follow its lifecycle: preserved during soft-delete/restore operations, and permanently deleted only when the parent todo is permanently deleted from trash. History entries cannot be modified or individually deleted by users, maintaining a complete and trustworthy audit trail.

The one-to-many relationship ensures each todo can have zero or more history entries, providing a complete timeline of how the todo has evolved over time. Entries are typically viewed in reverse chronological order (most recent first) based on the edited_at timestamp.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: The parent todo that was edited. {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when the edit operation occurred. Used for chronological ordering of edit history with most recent entries displayed first.

plainFields.name: title_change
plainFields.description: The new title value after the edit, if the title field was modified during this edit operation. Null if the title was not changed.

plainFields.name: description_change
plainFields.description: The new description value after the edit, if the description field was modified during this edit operation. Null if the description was not changed.

plainFields.name: start_date_change
plainFields.description: The new start date value after the edit, if the start date field was modified during this edit operation. Null if the start date was not changed.

plainFields.name: due_date_change
plainFields.description: The new due date value after the edit, if the due date field was modified during this edit operation. Null if the due date was not changed.
